claimStorageLimit: After all authorization/root checks and before any private materialization/SDK, atomically mkdir a private claim keyed by exact approval SHA256. A duplicate/concurrent claim fails. Protection assumes that retained storage is not externally removed.

preservation.boundary: bwrap read-only / except fresh private WORK, no network; no claim to all external state

ownedProcessObservation.observationLimit: 200ms sampled descendant/group rows and final PID+startTime/group check. Transient or escaped processes may be missed; no whole-host preservation claim.

stderrAdvisory.exactText: An issue was encountered verifying workloads. For more information, run "dotnet workload update".

statusAfterWritingThisReceiptExpected: The receipt is the sole remaining authorized addition. A separate read-only final check records the actual post-write status under the original /tmp invocation audit directory.
limitations: Binding-only cases do not execute application methods, ComposeRun, constructors or runtime prerequisites. Redis identity resolution does not establish Redis API behavior.
Cold means no deliberate EventStore preload; it does not prove absence of incidental preload. Host-first is the predeclared deliberate order and does not claim actual host execution order.
Process observations sample descendants/group every200ms; transient or escaped children may be missed. No whole-host state preservation claim.
The historical immediate SDK gate and earlier failed-run missing cursor/index-flag observations remain incomplete; current observations do not repair history.
The atomic claim prevents duplicate use while retained storage remains intact; external claim deletion is outside its guarantee. No retry or claim cleanup is authorized.
The outer adapter inherits the caller environment; names and a full mapping hash are retained. Every actual SDK command records its complete explicit environment.
